# Gold standard — Far North GC (farnorthgc.com)

What Board’s company delivers (compare GC sites to this):

## Positioning
- Anchorage / Eagle River licensed general contractor
- Kitchen, bath, flip / rehab, investor timelines (listing dates), occupied remodeled work
- Alaska license # shown; bonded/insured; workmanship warranty; written scope + finish date

## Site craft signals (rubric)
1. Clear primary jobs (kitchen/bath/flip/investor) above the fold  
2. Verifiable credentials (license #, bond/insurance, warranty)  
3. Before/after project proof with place names  
4. Distinct offers for homeowners vs investors (flip, BRRRR, multifamily, ADU)  
5. FAQ that kills objections (winter work, cost, timeline, damage behind walls)  
6. Single strong CTA (quote / call / email)  
7. Local specificity (neighborhoods, service area honesty)  
8. Professional trust without generic template spam  

Sites **could_benefit** if they lack several of these or look like thin brochure / builder.com default / Facebook-only.  
Sites **would_not_benefit** if they already match or beat this bar, or aren’t a GC website product fit (national chain portal, pure specialty, non-marketing site).
